title: Shortfall Make-Good Credits on Mobile Wallet Transfers: Error-Resolution Tool Card
content:
**Mobile Wallet** — Paloma's own credit for a wallet credit that arrived short.

## Situation and business effect
When the error-resolution team decides error found on an incorrect-amount notice, Paloma owes a make-good for the shortfall: one Paloma credit entry with credit reason `incorrect_amount_shortfall`, related to the credit-sent entry that arrived short and dated the day it is booked, which adds to the principal Paloma holds for the transfer. Once booked, Paloma's own shortfall credit stands on the transfer's ledger.

The tool `book_shortfall_makegood_2311834f` books that credit. Its effect, as the tool itself defines it:

- one Paloma credit entry (credit reason `incorrect_amount_shortfall`) is booked on the given Mobile Wallet transfer, dated today and pointing at the credit that arrived short, funded with Paloma's own money;
- the principal Paloma holds for the transfer rises by the amount and is held for a re-credit or a refund;
- the transfer's status is not changed, and nothing is sent to the wallet or the customer by this action.

## How it is invoked
`book_shortfall_makegood_2311834f` is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `wallet_transfer_id` | the reference number of the Mobile Wallet transfer whose credit arrived short, as returned by the Mobile Wallet transfer lookup | identifier |
| `related_entry_id` | the reference number of the credit-sent money movement that arrived short, as returned by the Mobile Wallet money-movement lookup for that transfer | identifier |
| `amount_usd` | the make-good Paloma puts in | USD, 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent |

The tool books the values as given.

## Return
A dictionary rendered as text with `ledger_entry_id` (reference of the new Paloma credit entry), `wallet_transfer_id`, `related_entry_id` (the short credit it answers), `amount_usd` (USD credited, 2 decimals), `entry_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, today) and `principal_held_usd` (USD Paloma now holds for the transfer, 2 decimals). A receipt with a `ledger_entry_id` means the credit stands.
